entries.subject: An invitation you do not decline
entries.body:
[i]“Twice now a picture of ours has come apart with your name in the margins. Come by the lot. Let us talk about how we work together — or whether we still do.”[/i]

The head of {studio} requests a meeting. The tone is polite. The tone is also final.

choices.label: Send regrets and a case of scotch

effects.label: A case of scotch instead of a meeting

effects.text: You declined the summit at {studio}. The lot remembers who does not show.

choices.outcome: The scotch is excellent. The silence that follows is not.

expire_effects.text: The invitation from {studio} expired unanswered. Doors close quietly in this town.
